‘DWTS’: Jackson Olson and Tyler Cameron are the Most Likely to Go Home Next, Say Experts

Jackson Olson and Tyler Cameron could be on the chopping block this week on 'DWTS.' Here's what experts predict.
by Emma McKee
Published on October 27, 2026
1 min read
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:44
Instaread
Share: Share on Twitter: Share on Facebook: Share via email: Copy link Link copied to the clipboard!

Tonight’s episode of DWTS raises the stakes for contestants with a double-elimination night. While anyone could be on the chopping block, experts say one person is heavily favored to go home. Jackson Olson is at the top of the danger zone, and Tyler Cameron is not far behind him.

Jackson Olson and Tyler Cameron’s time on ‘DWTS’ could be coming to an end

Two couples will face elimination on the “Horror Movie Night” broadcast of Dancing With the Stars. Market intelligence from Oddschecker says that Savannah Bananas infielder Jackson Olson has a 63% chance of going home at the end of this episode. Former Bachelorette contestant Tyler Cameron isn’t far behind him with a 59% risk of going home. 

“Double elimination nights are brutal because there’s simply nowhere to hide, and themed routines only ramp up the fright factor,” said Oddschecker spokesperson Steven Solomon. “Looking at how the market is reacting today, traders clearly feel Jackson Olson and Tyler Cameron are on borrowed time.”

Tatiana Ali, Connor Wood, and Julia Stiles also have a chance of going home. Not everyone is going into the night with the odds stacked against them, though. Amber Glenn and Maura Higgins both have a chance to win the entire season. Ezra Frech is the clear frontrunner, though, with a 58% chance of winning it all.

“At the opposite end, Ezra Frech continues to pull away from the pack in the winner’s market, and it’s going to take something truly special from someone else to knock him off his perch,” Solomon said.

Dancing With the Stars airs on ABC on Tuesdays at 8 p.m. ET.
